episodeTitle.zh: 《制定制胜战略的五个关键问题》| 罗杰·马丁（作家、顾问、演讲者）

guestBioOfficial.en: Roger Martin is one of the world’s leading experts on strategy and the author of Playing to Win, one of the most beloved books on strategy. He’s written extensively for the Harvard Business Review; consulted for dozens of Fortune 500 companies, including P&G, Lego, and Ford; and written 11 other books. In our conversation, we discuss: • The five key questions you need to answer to develop an effective strategy
guestBioOfficial.zh: 罗杰·马丁是战略领域的全球顶尖专家之一，也是最受欢迎的战略著作《Playing to Win》的作者。他为《哈佛商业评论》撰写了大量文章，为包括宝洁、乐高、福特在内的数十家《财富》500强公司提供咨询服务，并著有11本其他书籍。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：• 制定有效战略需要回答的五个关键问题

chapters.title: Defining strategy and the choice cascade
Playing to win vs. playing to play

title.en: 5 essential questions to craft a winning strategy | Roger Martin (author, advisor, speaker)
title.zh: 《制定制胜战略的五个关键问题》| 罗杰·马丁（作家、顾问、演讲者）

summary.en: Roger argues that strategy is an integrative activity answering five questions - winning aspiration, where to play, how to win, required capabilities, and management systems - and that you must choose either differentiation or low cost. He critiques how business schools teach strategy poorly, and insists great strategists are made through practice, not born. The episode gives ground-level PMs and ICs a practical framework for crafting real strategy.
summary.zh: Roger 主张战略是一项“整合性”活动，需回答五个问题——制胜抱负、在何处竞争、如何取胜、所需能力、以及支撑性管理体系——并且必须在“差异化”与“低成本”之间二选一。他批评商学院对战略的教学方式之多谬，并坚称伟大的战略家是练出来的，而非天生的。本期为一线 PM 与独立贡献者提供了一套制定真正战略的实用框架。
